# Mzu 3D Solar System

> A free, browser-based 3D visualization for exploring planets and selected Solar System objects.

## Start here

- [Interactive explorer](https://www.3dsolarsystem.net/): Rotate, zoom, select objects, follow a planet tour, and share a focused view.
- [Mercury](https://www.3dsolarsystem.net/mercury.html)
- [Mercury expedition](https://www.3dsolarsystem.net/mercury-expedition.html): Walk and jump through an artistic cratered plain under a huge Sun in a black, star-filled sky, discover five observation points including a lobate scarp and bright hollows, inspect a 3D specimen, and keep a journal in your browser.
- [Venus](https://www.3dsolarsystem.net/venus.html)
- [Venus expedition](https://www.3dsolarsystem.net/venus-expedition.html): Walk and jump through an artistic volcanic plain under a crushing orange sky in near-Earth gravity, discover five observation points, inspect a 3D specimen, and keep a journal in your browser.
- [Earth](https://www.3dsolarsystem.net/earth.html)
- [Moon expedition](https://www.3dsolarsystem.net/moon.html): Walk and jump through an artistic lunar landscape leaving footprints, discover five observation points, inspect a 3D rock, and keep a journal in your browser.
- [Mars](https://www.3dsolarsystem.net/mars.html)
- [Mars expedition](https://www.3dsolarsystem.net/mars-expedition.html): Walk and jump through an artistic Martian plain in lighter gravity, discover five observation points including dunes and layered rock, inspect a 3D specimen, and keep a journal in your browser.
- [Jupiter](https://www.3dsolarsystem.net/jupiter.html)
- [Jupiter descent](https://www.3dsolarsystem.net/jupiter-expedition.html): Ride an imagined probe down through Jupiter's cloud decks — drift past ammonia cirrus, a giant storm vortex, and deep lightning, fire the ascent thruster with Space, record five altitude-based discoveries, and keep a journal in your browser.
- [Saturn](https://www.3dsolarsystem.net/saturn.html)
- [Saturn ring cruise](https://www.3dsolarsystem.net/saturn-expedition.html): Cruise Saturn's ring plane alongside the Cassini spacecraft — skim glittering ice bands, cross the Cassini division, meet a shepherd moonlet, record five discoveries, and keep a journal in your browser.
- [Uranus sideways ring flight](https://www.3dsolarsystem.net/uranus-expedition.html): Thread Uranus's narrow charcoal-dark rings beside Voyager 2 — thin bands under a Sun that hangs over the tipped giant's pole, a shepherd moonlet, the famous 98° tilt marker, five discoveries, and a journal in your browser.
- [Uranus](https://www.3dsolarsystem.net/uranus.html)
- [Neptune](https://www.3dsolarsystem.net/neptune.html)

## Important limitation

This is an artistic educational visualization, not a live ephemeris or professional astronomy tool. Planet sizes, distances, orbital periods, and animation speed are adjusted for visibility. Some textures are artistic or procedural.

## Useful capabilities

- Interactive mouse, touch, and keyboard-friendly exploration
- Focus links using `?focus=Earth` (replace Earth with another supported object)
- Embeddable view using `?embed=1`
- Downloadable canvas snapshot
- Basic radius, semi-major-axis, and eccentricity information for selectable objects
